title: Cutoff-first full-invariant-cylinder sup-norm generator Cauchy question

authority.scope: Fix one generator-defect problem: observable scope, refinement stage, norm and quantifiers. This does not authorize changing the adopted model or declare the conjecture true.
authority.previous_goal_turn: PROGRESS: R-571 admission and checkpoint b3b01ab532b89f841ae907c1337d016c6c2ed4f4 completed. The present goal is distinct and setting-only.

question: For every fixed admissible parameter tuple, fixed h,N, base cutoff r0 and fixed f0 in the full invariant finite algebra at (r0,h,N), are the lifted generator values Cauchy in the inherited full-state sup norm as the local-state cutoff tends to infinity?

stage.pair_domain: integers s>r>=r0>=0; h,N>=0 fixed before r,s
stage.reason: This is the first ordered stage, not a simultaneous or diagonal r,h,N limit. No uniform h/N bound is smuggled in.

parameters.schedule: K_r=product of the first r+1 primes; M_s,r=2^r; M_psi,r=m0*4^r; Rmax,r=R0*2^r; Q_r=q0*2^r.
parameters.base_domain: Integers 1<=q0<=m0, R0>0; 0<epsilon<=1; beta,nu,lambda_s,eta_6,kappa_s,kappa_D,kappa_g,g and every inherited rate scale positive; m2,lambda_4 real; all other inherited parameters in their source domains.
parameters.fixed_meaning: Only the approved cutoff schedule changes with r,s. All inserted real parameters and rate scales are fixed before the comparison; no time acceleration, fitting or new scaling.
parameters.uniformity: No common modulus over different parameter tuples, h,N or base cutoff is asserted.

observables.algebra: A_(r,h,N)^inv = the FULL complex gauge- and actual anchor-cell-automorphism-invariant function algebra on Omega_v2(r,h,N,Q_r).
observables.normalization: ||f0||_infinity<=1; this is a homogeneous normalization, not a restricted passing subalgebra. Every finite complex observable is covered by scalar rescaling.
observables.transport: f_r=I_(rho0,rho) f0; f_s=I_(rho0,sigma) f0. The observable and base representative are fixed before the tail indices.
observables.support: Any finite source-box support is allowed, including gauge-invariant discontinuous indicators and hidden counting-coordinate observables. Do not require smoothness, energy localization, low modes or a selected subalgebra.
observables.representatives: R-571 composition identifies later cutoff representatives at the same h,N. The target quantifies every base representative; it does not claim compatibility between generators at different h,N.
observables.core_boundary: D^(h,N) is only the algebraic direct limit over r of the full invariant algebras. It is not assumed to be an invariant domain or core of any closed limiting generator.

operators.state_domain: D(L_rho)=C^(Omega_rho), with the invariant restriction justified only by R-570.
operators.observable_map_direction: I_(rho,sigma): A_rho -> A_sigma; I f=f composed with p
operators.generator: L_rho g(x)=sum_(a valid at x)c_rho,a(x)[g(a x)-g(x)]
operators.root_convention: All original PH/TR/LK/AP signed labelled incidences; duplicate K=2 labels, null rows and unmatched channels remain. Do not use the bookkeeping assignment to drop, average, divide or fit rates.
operators.defect: Delta_(rho,sigma) f_r = L_sigma I_(rho,sigma) f_r - I_(rho,sigma) L_rho f_r
operators.expanded_defect: For x in Omega_sigma, let y=p_(sigma,rho)x. Sum over ALL fine valid a: c_sigma,a(x)[f_r(p_(sigma,rho)(a x))-f_r(y)], minus sum over ALL coarse valid b at y: c_rho,b(y)[f_r(b y)-f_r(y)].
operators.sign_and_factor: Fine minus coarse; no factor 1/2 in L or Delta. The sqrt(c/2) convention belongs to B and is not moved into the generator.

norm.space: The full fine counting state space, never only the right-inverse image, a sampled subset or typical Gibbs states.
norm.weights: No Gibbs weighting, probability normalization, volume division or extra amplitude factor.
norm.time_units: Observable per unchanged external Markov time; the tolerance eta is in these same units.

quantifiers.formula: For all admissible fixed parameters,h,N,r0,f0 and eta>0, exists R>=r0 such that for all s>r>=R, d_(r,s)(f0)<eta.
quantifiers.tail_form: lim_(R->infinity) sup_(s>r>=R) d_(r,s)(f0)=0. The tail supremum is allowed to be +infinity before this is proved.
quantifiers.not_required: Exact finite-pair or eventual equality Delta=0 is not the target; it would be stronger. An adjacent-only limit d_(r,r+1)->0 is weaker and is not sufficient evidence.

falsifier.formula: Exists one fixed admissible parameter tuple,h,N,r0,f0 with ||f0||<=1 and eta0>0 such that for every R>=r0 there exist s>r>=R and x in Omega_(s,h,N) with |Delta f_r(x)|>=eta0.
falsifier.required_evidence: An exact unbounded-index construction or theorem, with source-valid states and all-root lower bound/cancellation audit. An exact adjacent sequence suffices if it has one fixed f0 and positive eta0 at arbitrarily large r.
insufficient: Different f0 chosen after each cutoff
A floating residual without certified nonzero lower bound
A witness only for modified rates, a different comparison or a smaller state carrier
falsifier.failure_scope: Refutes the universal full-cylinder sup-Cauchy claim for this unchanged model/comparison/parameter scope. It does not refute R-571 definition admission, all possible generator domains, Gibbs-L2 convergence, physical theories or TECT as a whole.

future_verdicts.PROVED: An exact all-quantifier tail bound omega_(params,h,N,r0,f0)(R)->0, uniform over every s>r>=R and every full fine state, with independent and hostile verification. A special-parameter or selected-observable proof is partial only.
future_verdicts.DISPROVED: An exact witness satisfying the fixed-data/unbounded-tail falsifier, independently reproduced with a full signed-root audit.
future_verdicts.HOLD_FOR_EVIDENCE: One precisely missing all-tail bound or witness identity and a source-specific reentry condition, after one bounded attempt. Neither finite PASS nor absence of a sampled failure proves the target.

why_this_target.role: A direct test of whether the existing sup-norm cylinder comparison can support convergent generator values at the FIRST ordered stage.
why_this_target.not_new_model: The Cauchy requirement is the research question, not an added assumption or an alteration of L, I, pi or the finite model.
why_this_target.not_semigroup_theorem: Even success would not by itself give closability, dissipativity/maximality, semigroup construction, h/N uniformity or the full ordered dynamics.
why_this_target.not_weak_convergence: A sup-norm failure can coexist with a different Gibbs-L2 or weak-limit route; such a route requires a separate target and cannot replace the verdict here.

bounded_future_attempt.finite_computation: Only an exact symbolic or directed-rounding diagnostic needed to certify a declared bound/witness; no new carrier and no sweep of finite sizes.
bounded_future_attempt.review_boundary: One bounded proof/counterexample checkpoint; if unresolved, retain one missing expression and reentry condition. Budget is by logical attempts, not an invented theorem runtime.
mandatory_hostile_checks: All root families and both signs retained
Hidden labels at epsilon=1 and zero occupation retained
Full fine state space, not injection image
Fixed f0 across an unbounded tail
All tail pairs, not merely adjacent differences
No inference to Gibbs-L2, h/N limits or physics

definition_audit.primary: A reproducible metadata/source-pin and hostile-mutation verifier; not a PAH defect evaluator.
definition_audit.independent: Written alternative common-algebra and pointwise-negation review in the companion contract, same-task authorship; no independent numerical dynamics run or external referee claimed.
definition_audit.Lean: NOT_RUN: no new analytic estimate or theorem is asserted by this preregistration. Future kernel scope must distinguish quantifier lemmas from the actual PAH tail bound.
definition_audit.synthesis_note: No new PDF: this is a target-setting exploration, not a proved or refuted gate-level result. Preserve R-571 synthesis bytes.

copy_ready_goal: PAH-V2-GD-001: Preserve R-570/R-571 and the adopted comparison contract. At fixed admissible parameters,h,N and base (r0,f0), for every f0 in the FULL invariant finite algebra with sup norm <=1, prove or disprove lim_R sup_(s>r>=R) ||L_s I_(r0,s)f0-I_(r,s)L_r I_(r0,r)f0||_infinity=0 on ALL fine counting states, in the original cutoff-first order. A disproof needs one fixed f0, eta0>0 and exact witnesses at arbitrarily large tail indices. Keep every signed root/rate/label and the original time, norm and model. Perform one bounded analytic attempt with independent and hostile verification; conclude PROVED, DISPROVED or HOLD_FOR_EVIDENCE with one missing expression. No Gibbs-L2 substitution, later-limit or physical promotion.
